```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
picks <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "picks")
roster <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "roster")
coaches <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "coaches")
# Last-school rule, 2014 classes on. One row per draftee-coach pair.
window_label <- "2014 classes on"
links <- coach_draftee_links(picks, roster, coaches, "last", 2014L) |>
  filter(group %in% position_group_levels())
# A draftee counts once per coach, so pairs are the unit of the shares.
pairs <- distinct(links, year, overall, coach_id, coach_name, group)
by_group <- pairs |>
  count(group, name = "draftees") |>
  mutate(share = draftees / sum(draftees))
coach_group <- pairs |>
  count(coach_name, group, name = "draftees") |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, position_group_levels()))
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# The two largest groups are the claim; the rest are context.
top_two <- by_group |> arrange(desc(draftees)) |> slice_head(n = 2) |> pull(group)
by_group <- by_group |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, rev(position_group_levels())),
    claim = as.character(group) %in% as.character(top_two)
  )
p <- ggplot(by_group, aes(100 * share, group)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = claim,
      tooltip = sprintf("%s: %d draftee-coach pairs (%.1f%%)", group, draftees, 100 * share),
      data_id = as.character(group)
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * share)), hjust = -0.1, size = 4.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#374151", `FALSE` = "#9CA3AF"), guide = "none") +
  expand_limits(x = 100 * max(by_group$share) * 1.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    title = "Share of draftee-coach pairs by position group",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Draftees of head coaches, ",
      window_label,
      "; the two largest groups in dark grey"
    ),
    x = "Share of draftee-coach pairs",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "draftee-position-groups-by-coach", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-coach
p_coach <- ggplot(coach_group, aes(draftees, group, colour = group)) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf("%s: %d %s draftees", coach_name, draftees, tolower(as.character(group))),
      data_id = coach_name
    ),
    position = position_jitter(height = 0.2, width = 0.1, seed = 1),
    size = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_colour_position() +
  labs(
    title = "Each head coach's draftees, by position group",
    subtitle = "One point per coach and position group",
    x = "Draftee-coach pairs",
    y = NULL,
    colour = NULL,
    caption = "Last-school rule, 2014 classes on. Hover a point for the coach."
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
card_interactive(p_coach, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```
